verdict.rationale: Claude Design can be driven from agent contexts: you can work in Claude Code with /design and pull design systems in via /design-sync, and it can be invoked from inside any Claude conversation. So an agent can create and modify designs, but only through Anthropic's own Claude surfaces, not an open programmatic interface. There is no documented write-capable public API (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404) and no first-party MCP server; the PenPot flow is Claude Design writing out through PenPot's MCP, not an MCP for Claude Design itself. Missing for 10: a public write-capable API or MCP server for third-party agents, documentation of the /design command's capabilities, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven design edits.
